prefs.title: Debug preferences
prefs.description: Runtime debug toggles. Both flags are persisted across restart in feature_settings under featureId='debug'.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging. DEBUG && console.log(...) lines across the main process start firing. Output lands in <userData>/logs/main.log and renderer.log.

devtools.description: Enable DevTools on newly-opened windows. Cmd+Opt+I works on any window opened after this is turned on. Existing windows are unaffected (Electron doesn't allow flipping devTools post-creation — close and re-open the window to inspect it).
